records.quote: In this context, the likelihood ratio order ≤lr, the usual stochastic order ≤st, the failure rate order ≤fr, and the mean residual life order ≤mrl are considered. A random variable X is considered to be less than a random variable Y: (i) if FX(x) ≥ FY(x), X ≤st Y for all x; (ii) if hX(x) ≥ hY(x), X ≤fr Y for all x; (iii) if µX(x) ≤ µY(x), X ≤mrl Y for all x; (iv) if fX(x)/fY(x), X ≤lr Y decreases in x.
records.family: Standard orders: st, fr (hazard/failure rate), mrl, lr
records.ambiguity: Paper uses ≤fr ('failure rate order') for the hazard-rate order.
